title: The giant bathroom?
content: Currently down a rabbit hole on mall world and GATE programs. I’m watching LoeyLanes video on it currently and what got me was the massive bathroom! I never thought anyone else dreamt of a big nonfunctional bathroom. Mine is basically a giant room with stalls but no doors and two or so toilets a stall. All the toilets either don’t work or they’re so dirty I wouldn’t use them IRL. It’s gender neutral as well so it’s always got boys and girls unless it’s the bathroom in the school but even then I always go into the wrong bathroom in the school dream too and it’s the same. No working toilets. Dirty and covered in poop. This is such a weird thing.
